alternative_hypothesis: H1: at least one anonymous slider produces a reproducible change in final shape, scale-free scalar geometry, bead parametrization, or iterations-to-convergence above preregistered numerical noise.
assumptions: KnotPlot runtime parameter dumps are authoritative for numerical defaults when the build reports a slider; a preregistered explicit default may be used for an anonymous GUI control that is accepted by the setter but omitted from `parameters` (S3 has user-confirmed frozen reset default value 1.40 and R2 reset switch OFF for this build; the enabled R2 sector reference uses S3=1.40).
reset all supplies the requested Damped baseline and collision fast supplies collision avoidance / No Collide.
Only the sector associated with the currently tested slider is explicitly enabled; unrelated controls remain at reset-all state.
No fitto, close, max-dr, stusplit, dstep or time increment override is allowed in the scientific campaign.
The 300-bead catalogue trefoil must be safe under the runtime defaults; otherwise the campaign fails closed rather than rescaling the seed.

The velocity-dependent sector is enabled with its runtime switch and tested under Damped as requested, even though KnotPlot emits a GUI/load note that Undamped dynamics is intended for velocity-dependent force. S7 is therefore interpreted as a Damped compatibility/response lane, not as the canonical intended Undamped use case.
R2 is OFF in reset-all state; the independent activation control differs from R2 ON reference only by the R2 switch, keeping both R2 numeric sliders fixed at their registered values.
edge_cases: Exact-zero endpoints are excluded from logarithmic/quadratic fits.
A zero runtime default makes multiplicative default-relative sweeping undefined and fails install calibration.

A slider absent from a sector-context `parameters` dump is permitted only when its frozen private axis contract supplies an explicit nonzero default and `verification=setter_acceptance`; otherwise install calibration fails closed.
Safety-cap termination is diagnostic non-convergence, not convergence at the cap.
A slider may change convergence time strongly while leaving final geometry nearly invariant.
Velocity-dependent-force results are regime-specific because this campaign intentionally retains Damped although the KnotPlot UI/load note recommends Undamped for that force.
An OFF sector may hide its numeric controls from the runtime parameter dump; compare accepted setters with explicit switch readback when reported, and retain weaker-evidence annotation when absent.

falsification_criteria.criterion: Any registered sector-enable command is rejected, any runtime-reportable slider fails numeric round-trip, or any explicitly preregistered non-reporting slider setter is rejected.
The trefoil is not safe under reset-all Damped defaults plus collision-fast; no rescaling is permitted in v0.2.5.
No anonymous slider among the eight registered axes produces shape, scalar or convergence-time response above the registered numerical noise floors.
One or more conditions fail to reach the adaptive plateau before the safety cap or finish unsafe.

null_hypothesis: H0: after correct sector-context runtime application and adaptive convergence, none of the eight anonymous slider sweeps produces a response above preregistered numerical noise relative to its sector-matched default reference.
objective: Measure one-slider-at-a-time default-relative response curves for eight GUI sliders across six force sectors, using sector-context runtime default interrogation and adaptive convergence rather than a fixed final relaxation count; distinguish shape effects, parametrization effects, damping/timescale effects, and velocity-dependent-force response. Separately quantify the R2 ON/OFF activation contrast at matched numeric settings.

observables.definition: Final default-relative normalized shape response for every anonymous slider condition.
Edge-spacing coefficient of variation used to separate parametrization response from embedded-shape response.
Campaign completeness, command/state verification and final-safety status.
Independent ON/OFF comparison for R2 at identical frozen numeric defaults, reported separately from eight slider sweeps.

predictions: Amplitude-like sliders may primarily alter final geometry magnitude; exponent-like sliders may change response-law shape.
A predominantly tangential redistribution control may change edge-spacing statistics more strongly than arclength-resampled embedded shape.
A damping-like control may change N_conv more strongly than final D_shape.
The velocity-dependent control may alter transient and/or final geometry under Damped, but any such response is explicitly conditional on this non-intended regime pairing.
An R2 OFF-versus-ON contrast at identical numeric defaults may differ from the continuous S3 strength response, so it is reported separately.
research_question: For one catalogue trefoil in the user-requested Damped + No-Collide regime, how does each of eight anonymous GUI slider parameters change the adaptively converged geometry or convergence timescale relative to its sector-context runtime default, while all unrelated controls remain at reset-all defaults? Is the R2 switch-ON reference distinguishable from its reset-default R2-OFF state at identical numeric values?

steps.operation: Runtime-probe eight anonymous slider parameters in six enabled sector contexts; verify assignment-form setters and sector switches; for a preregistered non-reporting control use its frozen explicit default plus setter-acceptance verification; verify the Damped + collision-fast regime; and export exactly one safe trefoil during installation.

Generate six enabled-sector default references, one additional matched R2-OFF activation control, and eight default-relative one-slider-at-a-time sweeps on the quarter-octave ladder with zero endpoints.
For every condition stream small go-quantum blocks into one persistent KnotPlot process and stop by the preregistered geometry/scalar plateau rule rather than a fixed final iteration count.
Compute final shape, scale-free scalar, parametrization and convergence-time responses against the matching sector reference.
Certify coordinate-derived scalar metrics with C++17/pybind11 FP64 against Python FP64.

Report the anonymous tangential response as parametrization-versus-shape, the damping response as convergence-timescale-versus-final-shape, and the velocity-dependent response as a Damped-regime compatibility diagnostic.
After commitment-verified reveal only, attach GUI slider and sector names to the frozen anonymous response curves, including the registered Damped-regime caveat for the velocity-dependent sector.

Execute one separately registered R2 switch-OFF control with the identical S3/S4 numerical default setters as the enabled R2 reference, and compare final shapes without pooling this binary contrast into any slider response fit.
